crm_notes:
Lead: Head of Product (Elena Rios). Use-case: search + recommendations inside product plus nightly batch re-embed for changelogs. Initial interest in hosted API for dev speed; now pushing toward Dedicated due to cost and egress concerns. Key quotes: "we need predictable cost for embedding refreshes"; "latency under 50ms 95th for search path".

Recent activity (bullets):
- 2026-01-15: Intro call (Samir) — overview of platform, ask: vector DB compatibility, bulk embed jobs.
- 2026-01-28: Tech deep-dive (Leah) — reviewed Apache Arrow ingestion, discussed Faiss vs managed DBs; flagged throughput targets (200 qps search, 50k emb/day batch).
- 2026-02-08: Demo — Hosted API demo (textgen + embeddings), sample queries against product docs.
- 2026-02-22: POC kickoff — staged hosted POC for embeddings pipeline; team set up sandbox project, provided API keys. Fireflies transcript id attached.
- 2026-02-27: Security call — Bundlore Security asked for SOC2 attestation, KMS flow, retention controls; we shared security FAQ and draft diagram (drive link).
- 2026-03-01: Cost modeling workshop — built rough unit economics comparing hosted per-token embedding calls vs Dedicated reserved nodes for nightly re-embeds.
- 2026-03-03: Dedicated trial request — engineering asks for throughput bench on equivalent Dedicated config; asked Redwood for sample pricing for 3-month reserved nodes.

POC specifics / Requirements summary:
- Workloads: primary semantic search (customer queries), secondary: realtime recommendations + nightly batch embedding refresh across ~120M documents (incremental).
- Throughput targets: 200 qps (search), 1000 concurrent embedding requests in batch windows, nightly job to process 50k new/changed items per hour.
- Latency targets: 95th percentile < 50ms for search token generation + retrieval path; embedding generation pipeline target: average embed latency < 120ms.
- Vector DB integration: currently using an in-house Faiss service (k-NN), evaluating migration to managed vector DBs (Pinecone) or staying with Faiss on Dedicated hosts. Wants guidance on best practices for sharding, persisted KV caches, and cold-start behavior.
- Model preferences: open models (Llama 2 13B quantized) for cost, but open to higher-quality variants if latency SLOs preserved. Must support quantized weights and multi-GPU routing.
- Routing/fallback: prefer dynamic routing — hosted for low-volume experiments, Dedicated for steady production; automatic fallback to smaller model if autoscaler saturated. Redwood's routing/fallback demo resonated.
- Security/compliance: SSO for dev + prod, audit logging per-request, KMS for key rotation, optional data residency to keep embeddings in us-east-1. Retention policy: 30-day transient request logs, long-term usage metrics only.

Business context / buying committee:
- Elena Rios (Head of Product) — champion, cares about latency & developer velocity.
- Marco Diaz (CTO) — cost & infra alignment; leans toward Dedicated if unit costs predictable.
- Priya Menon (Security lead) — SOC2 + KMS + audit logs required.
- Julian Park (SRE lead) — owns integration to Faiss, concerned about batch window and network egress.

Pricing / procurement notes:
- Bundlore has $200k budget earmarked for embeddings/search infra in FY26. Procurement timeline accelerated if we can show a 30% reduction in per-embed cost vs current hosted plan.
- They requested a 3-month Dedicated trial quote + optional conversion discount to 12-month reserved commit.

Technical asks for POC (action items):
- Provide sample Dedicated config (GPU type, node counts) that meets 200 qps search and supports 50k/hr batch embeddings. Include expected token/sec and embed throughput.
- Provide step-by-step vector DB integration guide with Faiss and an example config for persisted KV caches (suggest sharding strategy).
- Run a small stress test on Redwood Dedicated trial (we schedule week of 2026-03-10). Need test scripts and result template.
- Security: deliver SOC2 summary, KMS integration doc, and sample audit log export (by 2026-03-08).

Sales/Eng notes (shorthand):
- Elena: product-led demo -> wants sandbox for PMs to try; quoted: "If it's easy we roll fast".
- CTO: cares numbers. ask: show total cost for nightly re-embed using hosted vs 3-node ded.
- SRE: wants local Faiss host blueprint; will need limited egress.

Next steps (detailed):
1) Provide Dedicated sizing + pricing by 2026-03-05 (Samir).
2) Security package upload to Drive by 2026-03-05 (Security team).
3) Schedule Dedicated trial stress window week of 2026-03-10 (Leah + SRE).
4) Post-trial review + legal pricing table for annual commit by 2026-03-25.

Open questions / Risks:
- Nightly batch of 50k/hr will spike egress/cost — need accurate cost model for embedded vector outbound.
- Faiss migration complexity — SRE may prefer to keep in-house unless managed DB shows clear ops savings.
- Will Dedicated trial be permitted in their cloud region (us-east-1) with required KMS integration?
